profile_text.body:
DeepAI is a San Francisco-based creative AI platform founded in late 2016, when it describes itself as having launched the first browser-based text-to-image generator. The company describes itself as an all-in-one platform built for a broad range of users, from hobbyists and professional artists to developers. From a single prompt, users can generate images, edit photos, chat with an AI that browses the internet, create short videos, compose original music, or converse with a realistic AI using their voice, all accessible directly in a browser or via APIs. The company emphasizes what it calls radical accessibility, including full ownership of created content for users and real email support.

Beyond its consumer platform, DeepAI also takes on custom technical work for governments, nonprofits, and research organizations, including specialized computer vision systems and perception and mapping pipelines across complex sensor networks. The company runs an initiative it calls AI for Good, focused on environmental stewardship, conservation, and social impact, with an emphasis on shortening the observation-to-action loop for detection and response work. In 2025, DeepAI became the major sponsor of Tuvalu's national futsal team, supporting the team's return to international competition after a fourteen-year absence.

The site's held facts list one tracked product under the Image and Graphic Design category, identified simply as DeepAI, with image generation noted as its primary function. The DEEPAI trademark and the Dolphin Design trademark are registered in the United States and other territories, per the company's own copyright notice.
